title: What are archived ideas?
description:
If multiple and similar ideas have been created, use the merge function to keep only one and archive others. 

Archiving ideas is also a way to keep your project clean without deleting idea - as an archived idea can always be restored.

enrichedData.purpose: Enables project managers to consolidate duplicate ideas and maintain a clean project workspace while preserving archived content for future reference.
useCases: Merge similar or duplicate ideas into a single consolidated idea
Archive redundant ideas to reduce clutter without permanent deletion
Restore previously archived ideas when needed
